items.title: Anime Gambling Horror Game Ditches Free Steam Demo So It Doesn't Get Ripped Off By AI
items.excerpt: The developers of Drunken Goddess Reflux cancelled their free Steam demo for a closed beta, fearing genAI copycats would clone the game before launch.

items.title: Masahiro Sakurai says original games will be harder for AI to rip off, but originality also makes them harder to sell
items.excerpt: Smash Bros and Kirby creator Masahiro Sakurai argues AI has made existing design problems worse, and that originality is the defense against AI clones even if it hurts marketability.

items.title: "Our industry is rotting" and AI "pushed things over the edge," so the DayZ creator wants to change how games are made
items.excerpt: Dean Hall says AI pushed the industry over the edge and launches BRUTAL, a free open-source development framework, with the Kerbal Space Program creator on board.

items.title: Dragon Ball's Goku Voice Actor 'Furious' Over AI Videos Using Her Voice Without Permission
items.excerpt: Masako Nozawa, voice of Goku, condemns AI users cloning her voice without permission, calling it outright theft, as voice-cloning pressure on actors grows.

items.title: Nvidia App Update Will Let AI Agents Tune Your Graphics Card, but Some Users are Warning to Turn It Off
items.excerpt: Following the RTX Spark launch, the Nvidia app adds a toggle letting AI agents control GPU settings, prompting user warnings about handing agents that access.

items.title: Konami Does 'Not Believe The Market Will Shift Significantly' Because Of AI
items.excerpt: In a new financial report, the Silent Hill and Metal Gear publisher says developers' idea-making process 'cannot be replaced easily' by AI.

items.title: Sega and Creative Assembly remove Total War: Shogun 2 remaster from sale
items.excerpt: After overwhelmingly negative Steam reviews citing AI-upscaled artwork and performance problems, Sega pulled the Shogun 2 remaster from sale, saying it fell short of its standards.

items.title: [오늘의 스팀] AI를 속여라, 협동 신작 '스캠 위드 유어 프렌즈'
items.excerpt: 생성형 AI를 상대로 사기극을 벌이는 협동 시뮬레이션 '스캠 위드 유어 프렌즈'가 스팀 앞서 해보기 출시 후 최고 인기 게임 최상위권에 올랐다. 서버 불안정과 음성 인식 오류는 과제.

items.title: Wizards of the Coast union expands, protests generative AI usage
items.excerpt: Dungeons & Dragons and Magic: The Gathering teams at Wizards of the Coast are unionizing and calling on Hasbro to stop pushing generative AI.

items.title: Capcom aims to enhance its RE Engine with AI to accelerate QA, debugging, and data processing
items.excerpt: Capcom plans to add AI to RE Engine for QA and debugging, open-source some improvements, and eventually evolve it into an 'AI-generation game engine'.

items.title: Sega won't "entrust the creative aspect of games to AI," but is using tech to "improve efficiency"
items.excerpt: Sega executive Tsuyoshi Saito says the company is 'very cautious' with generative AI in development, keeping it away from creative work while using it for efficiency elsewhere.

items.title: Interview: The Video Game Industry's Vibe-Coded Future
items.excerpt: Take-Two's former head of AI and Godot Engine's executive director discuss the Claude Opus-shaped problem facing game development as vibe coding floods the industry.

items.title: How a 3-person team is using AI to recreate Pride and Prejudice in Fortnite
items.excerpt: A three-person team uses Fortnite and AI startup Dreamlands to turn Jane Austen's Pride and Prejudice into a stage for interactive fan fiction.

items.title: Black Myth: Wukong sequel devs said no to AI because of Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey
items.excerpt: Game Science says it is not using AI on the Black Myth sequel, inspired by Christopher Nolan's practical filmmaking on The Odyssey.
